integrity.method: exact finite-state Bellman rational policy iteration
integrity.result: nonmyopic choice first at nine vertices uniquely for complete multipartite K_(1,2,6)

scientific_limitations: The minimality statement is confined to unweighted connected complete multipartite graphs with at most nine vertices.
The witness compares conditional optimal future cover times after two proposed moves and does not classify larger graph orders.
The finite classification relies on an included exact-arithmetic checker; no independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
title: The first nonmyopic two-choice cover decision on complete multipartite graphs
